definitions.gloss: temple/shrine viewing fee; admission fee for religious sites
definitions.explanation: The fee charged to enter and view a temple, shrine, or other religious/historical site.

examples.japanese: ⟦{金閣寺|きんかくじ}→金閣寺：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{拝観料|はいかんりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧500⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The admission fee for Kinkaku-ji is 500 yen.

examples.japanese: {拝観料|はいかんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}って→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦{境内|けいだい}→境内：12095_keidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I paid the admission fee and entered the temple grounds.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{拝観料|はいかんりょう}⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
FORMATION: ⟦{拝観|はいかん}→拝観：noentry⟧ (respectful viewing) + {料|りょう} (fee). The {拝|はい} is the same character as in {拝|おが}む (to pray to, to bow before), and it frames entry as a reverent act rather than the purchase of a ticket. That is why the word is confined to temples, shrines, and comparable historical sites.

RELATED FEE TYPES: Japanese picks the fee word by the kind of place, and the four are not interchangeable.
- {拝観料|はいかんりょう}: temples and shrines
- ⟦{入館料|にゅうかんりょう}→入館料：07141_nyuukanryou⟧: buildings whose name ends in 〜{館|かん} — museums, galleries, halls
- ⟦{入場料|にゅうじょうりょう}→入場料：07056_nyuujouryou⟧: grounds, venues, and events
- ⟦{観覧料|かんらんりょう}→観覧料：noentry⟧: places you go to look at something — a garden, an observation deck, a zoo

COLLOCATIONS:
- {拝観料|はいかんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: pay the viewing fee
- {拝観料|はいかんりょう}⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧: admission free (sign wording; no particle)
- {拝観料|はいかんりょう}⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧: viewing fee included, e.g. in a tour price

VERB FORM: ⟦{拝観|はいかん}→拝観：noentry⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is to view a temple or shrine. It is humble in origin — the speaker lowers their own act of looking — so it is not used of ordinary sightseeing.

CULTURAL NOTE: major temples in ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧ and ⟦{奈良|なら}→奈良：27451_nara⟧ charge a {拝観料|はいかんりょう}, commonly a few hundred yen, and it often covers only the main hall or the garden rather than the whole ⟦{境内|けいだい}→境内：12095_keidai⟧. Most neighbourhood ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧ charge nothing at all.
